events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On September 13, 1996, the world lost influential rapper and actor Tupac Shakur. He would have been 55 this year, born June 16, 1971.

angles.name: Tupac tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, whose impact on music and culture continues to resonate decades on. His powerful voice and stories remain as relevant as ever.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who died on September 18, 1970. He would have been 83 this year, born November 27, 1942.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Today, we remember the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, a true guitar icon whose music continues to inspire generations. His legend lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road tribute
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' 'Abbey Road'! That iconic album cover and timeless tracks still sound as fresh today as they did in '69. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, born September 7, 1951, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde birthday
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and inspiring us all with her incredible voice and attitude.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, born September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released in the UK. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got your hands on an iPod? Today marks 25 years since Apple changed the game for portable music. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon birthday tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we pay tribute to the visionary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, born October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' iconic 'White Album'! A sprawling masterpiece that showcased their incredible range. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, November 24, 1991, we remember the legendary Freddie Mercury, who passed away at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year, born September 5, 1946.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. His voice, stage presence, and timeless music continue to captivate the world.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal moment in their evolution and sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, December 8, 1980, the world lost a musical legend, John Lennon. He would have been 86 this year, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon death tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, a voice for peace and a musical visionary, on the anniversary of his passing. His legacy continues to inspire generations.
